claim.claim-text: 1. A circuit comprising:

in the first mode, the plurality of integer arithmetic logic blocks is configured to perform a real multiplication on first integer operands of a first size; and in the second mode, the plurality of integer arithmetic logic blocks is configured to perform a complex multiplication on second integer operands of a second size that is smaller than the first size.
2. The circuit of claim 1, wherein the second integer operands include at least two real values and two imaginary values.
3. The circuit of claim 1, further comprising:

a set of input connections; and bit remapping circuitry that selectively connects the input connections to the integer arithmetic logic blocks based on the mode selection input, the bit remapping circuitry being operable in both the first mode and the second mode.

4. The circuit of claim 3, further comprising: interconnection circuitry among the plurality of integer arithmetic logic blocks, the interconnection circuitry comprising a plurality of registers and multiplexers, the registers and multiplexers being operable in both the first mode and the second mode.
5. The circuit of claim 1, further comprising: an adder that generates a result that is a sum of partial products.
6. The circuit of claim 1, wherein:
the first integer operands of the first size are sixteen-bit integers; and the second integer operands of the second size are eight-bit integers.

7. The circuit of claim 1, further comprising: a plurality of output connections that, in the first mode and the second mode, provide a plurality of partial products, wherein a bit width of each partial product is based on a number of partial products provided.
8. The circuit of any of the preceding claim, wherein the circuit is a field programmable gate array, FPGA.
9. The circuit of any of the preceding claims wherein:

the second integer operands comprise complex numbers represented as A + jB and C + jD; and results of the complex multiplication comprise a real component with value AC - BD and an imaginary component with value AD + BC.

10. A machine-readable storage medium containing instructions that, when executed by one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to control configuration of a circuit according to any one of claims 1 to 9.
11. A method comprising:
12. The method of claim 11, wherein the second integer operands include at least two real values and two imaginary values.

13. The method of claim 11, further comprising: selectively connecting, by the circuit, input connections to the integer arithmetic logic blocks based on the first mode selection input and the second mode selection input.
14. The method of claim 13, further comprising: interconnecting, by the circuit, the plurality of integer arithmetic logic blocks.
15. The method of claim 11, further comprising: generating, by an adder, a result that is a sum of partial products.
